title: Manage vehicle
notFoundBody: The vehicle may have been deleted or does not belong to your shop.
loadErrorBody: Something went wrong while fetching data. Please try again.
forbiddenBody: You need permission to view and edit vehicles to use this workspace.
readOnlyNotice: You have view-only access — changes made here will not be saved.

header.trips: {count, plural, =0 {No trips yet} one {# trip} other {# trips}}
header.viewListingDisabled: This vehicle is not public yet — the listing page exists only after marketplace approval.

nav.toggleNotAllowed: Motorbikes do not offer chauffeured rental.
nav.toggleLastService: The vehicle must keep at least one service — enable another one before turning this off.
nav.toggleNoPermission: You do not have permission to edit vehicles.

serviceToggle.priceLossTitle: Turning this service off clears its dedicated prices
serviceToggle.priceLossBody: You will have to enter prices again when you re-enable it. Confirmed bookings are not affected.

disabledSection.title: {service} is turned off
disabledSection.body: Flip the {service} switch in the left menu to edit these settings. Other services keep working as usual.

common.discardBody: What you edited in this section has not been saved.

information.plateHelp: The plate number does not change after registration. Changing it on a public vehicle sends the vehicle back to review.
information.addressMissing: This vehicle is not assigned to a branch yet. Pick a branch in the management portal to give it a public location.
information.addressNoStreet: The branch has no street address yet — click Edit to add one.
information.addressMapPending: This address could not be located on the map yet. The text address is still used; the map appears once coordinates are resolved.
information.addressSharedTitle: This branch holds {count, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}}
information.addressSharedBody: Editing the branch address changes the public location of all of them. To place this vehicle elsewhere, create or pick another branch in the management portal.
information.lockedNotice: This vehicle is live on the marketplace: plate number, transmission, fuel type and manufacture year are locked. Everything else — pricing included — takes effect immediately.
information.lockedField: Locked while the vehicle is on the marketplace. Remove it from the marketplace to change this.

images.reorderToggle: Allow drag and drop to reorder photos.
images.minimumHint: A cover photo is required to list the vehicle. Each slot holds one photo; "Other photos" accepts several (up to {max} gallery photos).
images.mainImageHelp: Shown on the vehicle card and listing — a clear front view works best.

helper.dashboard: Instrument cluster with the odometer readable

images.legacyNotice: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} uploaded earlier have no slot yet — shown under "Other photos". Drag them into a slot or keep them and save.

documents.title: Vehicle documents
documents.subtitle: Registration, inspection, insurance and other papers — stored privately, opened only by people with permission.

tripHistory.title: Trip history
tripHistory.empty: This vehicle has no trips yet.
tripHistory.forbidden: You need permission to view bookings and rental requests to see trip history.

pricing.selfDriveSubtitle: The default price applies to any day without a custom price.
pricing.withDriverSubtitle: Prices include the driver's pay but exclude fuel and toll surcharges (if any).
pricing.withDriverEstimateHint: Route types without a price are estimated from the nearest tier; you confirm the final price when approving.

autoAccept.activeBody: The system will automatically accept rental requests that meet the criteria below, without manual approval.
autoAccept.inactiveBody: Every rental request waits for your decision within 60 minutes.
autoAccept.toggleBody: Save response time and increase your conversion rate.
autoAccept.instantBody: Renters do not wait for manual approval. The system confirms automatically when a driver is free.
autoAccept.minLeadDriverHint: Notice required to schedule a driver (1 – 72 hours)
autoAccept.routesHint: For your prioritisation only; the system still accepts every route the vehicle serves.

rules.schedule: The vehicle is free for the whole period, including the turnaround buffer.
rules.window: Pickup and return fall inside the vehicle's handover hours.
rules.quote: The price is final — estimates still wait for you.
rules.longTerm: Long-term rentals are never auto-accepted: you always confirm the schedule.
rules.driver: An active driver with a valid licence is free for the window.
rules.hold: Chauffeured trips on the commission track still wait for your approval before the renter pays the hold.

autoAccept.policyTitle: * Cancellation policy note for auto-accepted trips:
autoAccept.policyBody: Auto-confirmed requests follow the standard Xe Prime cancellation policy. Cancelling a trip after it was auto-confirmed may lower your reliability score or limit your vehicle's visibility.
autoAccept.capabilityNoFeature: Your current plan does not include Drivers — chauffeured auto-acceptance cannot be enabled yet.
autoAccept.capabilityNoDriver: No active drivers yet. Add a driver in the management portal before enabling.
autoAccept.capabilityOk: {count, plural, one {# active driver} other {# active drivers}} — the system assigns a free driver on acceptance.

validation.minMax: Minimum notice cannot exceed maximum notice

delivery.title: Home delivery
delivery.subtitle: Win more bookings by delivering the vehicle to the renter's door.
delivery.inheritedBody: Saving here creates a vehicle-specific policy (deposit, delivery, overtime and discounts copied from the shop, then your changes applied). Other vehicles are not affected.
delivery.overriddenTitle: This vehicle uses its own policy
delivery.overriddenBody: Changes apply to this vehicle only, from new bookings onward.
delivery.noShopPolicyTitle: The shop has no rental policy yet
delivery.noShopPolicyBody: You can enable delivery for this vehicle; the remaining sections (collateral, overtime, discounts) take safe defaults and are editable under Rental terms.
delivery.radiusHint: Beyond this radius renters see "The host will discuss the fee directly" — you quote manually on the booking.
delivery.tiersHint: Enter 0 for a free distance. Fees are not per km: each tier is a fixed amount so renters see the number up front.
delivery.estimateNote: The number shown to renters is an ESTIMATE from road distance; you still confirm the fee on the booking.
delivery.offNote: Off — renters cannot request home delivery when booking.

handover.title: Handover hours
handover.subtitle: Set the hours when you can hand over and take back the vehicle. Requests outside these hours are rejected at submission.
handover.allDay: No slots = any time of day.
handover.bufferHint: Preparation time (cleaning, charging, checks) added to the calendar after each trip — two trips cannot be closer than this.
handover.scopeNote: Applies to NEW holds and rescheduled trips from now on. Existing bookings and calendar entries are not recalculated.

validation.startEnd: End time must be after start time
validation.bufferRange: Buffer must be between 0 and 1440 minutes

terms.selfDriveSubtitle: Set the legally binding requirements renters must meet before receiving the keys.
terms.withDriverSubtitle: The process binding host, driver and renter to keep the service safe.
terms.collateralInherited: Inherited from the shop policy — changing it here creates a vehicle-specific policy.
terms.collateralNoneHint: * Makes it as easy as possible for renters to book quickly.

collateralOption.none: No cash or motorbike collateral required

terms.documentsSubtitle: Choose the minimum legal documents the renter must present in person.
terms.documentsSubtitleDriver: Documents the renter must present to the driver before departure

docPreset.citizen: Driver's licence (verified) & Citizen ID (verified via VNeID)

docPresetDriver.citizen: Valid ID card / Citizen ID (driver photographs it for verification)

terms.verifyHint: VNeID means your staff verifies manually through the renter's VNeID app. XePrime is not integrated with the national identity API.
terms.requireAcceptance: Require renters to accept the terms before sending a request
terms.requireAcceptanceDriver: Sign the chauffeured rental contract (Xe Prime template)
terms.requireAcceptanceHint: Renters must tick their agreement in the booking flow; the time of acceptance is stored on the request and booking.
terms.contractTemplate: The contract template is available under Contracts & documents.
terms.termsSubtitle: House rules the renter must follow while using the vehicle.
terms.termsPlaceholder: E.g. No smoking in the car; no pets without a carrier; return on time with the agreed battery/fuel level…
terms.termsHint: Shown to renters on the listing and in the booking confirmation step. Confirmed bookings keep the terms as of booking time.
terms.depositUnsupported: Not collectable through the system yet — available once wired to the hold and reconciliation flow.
terms.depositNote: Different from self-drive collateral: this is an advance payment for the trip itself.
terms.publicNotice: This vehicle is public — changing collateral only updates the marketplace label, no re-review needed.

surcharges.title: Chauffeur service surcharges
surcharges.subtitle: Renters pay these extras directly to the driver based on what actually happens on the trip.

threshold.waiting: After {minutes} minutes past the agreed pickup time
threshold.long_distance: When the total distance exceeds {km} km per day
threshold.longDistanceField: Km per day before the surcharge applies
threshold.overnight: Covers the driver's overnight stay on out-of-town trips

surcharges.flowNote: These rates are published to renters before they send a request and frozen on the booking. Actual charges are recorded at trip settlement — never added to the initial price automatically.

validation.amountRequired: An enabled surcharge needs an amount above 0

operationsTab.title: Operations & rental terms
operationsTab.hint: Handover hours, instant booking, rental terms and surcharges
operationsTab.serviceOff: This vehicle does not offer this service.
